summary: BTC/USD completed 01:00 and 02:00 UTC intervals formed a two-hour downside volatility burst, independently corroborated across Bybit spot, Bybit linear, and Twelve Data. Bybit spot also reported abnormal turnover, strongest at 02:00 (range robust z +5.03; volume robust z +6.14). The 03:00 interval normalized. Evidence supports a discrete volatility-and-turnover event, not directional order flow, liquidations, persistent liquidity stress, or cross-market causation.
surface: ARGUS authenticated candle-volume versus order-flow classification
NEXUS cross-provider representation reconciliation and event-time integrity

evidence.note: Completed-hour normalization after the two-hour burst.
Linear volume is representation-specific and was not fused with spot BTC volume.
No volume field was returned; only price-range corroboration was used. The forming 04:00 interval was excluded.
Point-in-time snapshot only; no historical depth baseline.

evidence.finding: The independently reconciled two-hour range burst plus abnormal direct-venue spot turnover, followed by 03:00 normalization, supports a discrete downside volatility-and-turnover impulse within an episodic-shock regime. It does not establish aggressor direction, historical liquidity stress, liquidation causality, or cross-asset synchronization.

data_gaps: No historical depth or trade sequence was acquired; order-flow direction, persistent liquidity, auction behavior, liquidations, funding, basis, open interest and exchange flow remain unknown.
No fresh direct NQ/MNQ, GC/MGC, SI, DXY, Treasury/rate-proxy or volatility-index evidence was acquired; cross-market causation is unknown.
K-line and Twelve Data responses exposed event timestamps but no provider-specific retrieval timestamp; the contemporaneous Bybit orderbook server timestamp anchors retrieval.
regime_implication: A discrete two-hour BTC downside volatility-and-turnover burst normalized by the next completed hour, supporting episodic shock behavior rather than a continuously elevated volatility state. No trading or routing behavior was changed.
next_decisive_check: Acquire direct NQ/GC/SI/USD/rates/volatility evidence for 01:00–02:00 UTC and the next completed BTC hour; test whether joint range-plus-turnover expansion persists or was isolated.

argus.finding: Authenticated Bybit spot candles reported joint abnormal range and turnover at 01:00 and 02:00 UTC; the 02:00 interval reached +5.03 range robust-z and +6.14 volume robust-z. This is candle-volume evidence, not authenticated aggressor order flow or liquidation evidence.

nexus.finding: The burst and 03:00 normalization reconcile across Bybit spot, Bybit linear, and Twelve Data price representations; the forming 04:00 interval was excluded and representation-specific volumes were not fused.
